tasks.title: Extract the named-member editor used by `SecretRequestCreateDialog.addCustomField()` into one reusable piece (component or composable) carrying the name/value list plus its validation.
acceptance_criteria: Refuses reserved names (`key`, `login`, `url`) with a reason, duplicates, and blanks
Extract the VALIDATION at minimum; the request dialog's "name a member that does not exist yet" affordance is request-only and must not be forced onto the secret dialogs

tasks.title: Point `SecretRequestCreateDialog` at the extracted piece so there is one implementation, not two.
Add additional fields to `SecretCreateDialog`: add and remove named members before the secret exists.
Include the members in the payload so the store encrypts them as one blob.
acceptance_criteria: The server must still receive only ciphertext; no member name or value in plaintext

tasks.title: Pre-fill `SecretEditDialog` from the decrypted blob so existing members are shown with their names and values.
Allow renaming a member, changing its value, adding another and removing one, writing the whole blob back.
acceptance_criteria: Removing the last member yields an EMPTY blob, not null, so "none" stays distinguishable from "not loaded"

tasks.title: Vitest for the shared editor: reserved names, duplicates and blanks refused with a reason; add and remove work.

Vitest for edit: existing members are pre-filled from the decrypted secret; rename, re-value, add and remove all round-trip; removing the last member sends an empty blob.
Verify each new/modified spec scenario is driven by a test or carries a reason-bearing `@e2e exclude`.
Translate new UI strings into all 36 locales so the parity ratchet stays green.
Run the full sweep — hydra gates, vitest, eslint, prettier, `openspec validate --strict` — and confirm a `@spec` anchor or reason-bearing exclude on every changed method.
